records.text: Owens said she believed virtually every descriptive trait of dissociative identity disorder matched Erika Kirk and that she did not think Kirk knew she was lying.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Virtually every descriptive trait of somebody who has dissociative personality disorder matches the experience I am having watching Erika (Erika Kirk), okay? Floating between different identities seems to be suffering from like an amnesia. I don't think she knows she's lying.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. This is a lay psychological opinion by Owens about a living person. Public behavior cannot establish dissociative identity disorder, memory impairment, or lack of awareness of lying without a qualified clinical assessment, which is not available.

records.text: Owens asserted that the CIA trained people to dissociate so that serial killers could be used as weapons while their personalities remained inaccessible to police.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Our government did a lot of experiments with that. verification.notes: Official Senate records confirm abusive CIA behavioral-modification experiments, including drugs, hypnosis, unwitting subjects, and severe ethical violations. The reviewed official history does not document training serial killers as weapons or locking alternate personalities away from police. No reliable source supporting that specific allegation was found, but absence from surviving records is not direct contradictory proof.

sources.title: 1977 Senate hearing on Project MKULTRA
sources.relevance: Authoritative record of documented MKULTRA activities; it does not substantiate the serial-killer weapon claim.
